description_en: Adds a live streaming domain name. You can add only one domain name at a time
description_zh: 调用该接口添加直播域名，一次只能提交一个域名
kebab_example: aliyun live add-live-domain --live-domain-type liveVideo --domain-name example.aliyundoc.com --biz-region cn-beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddLiveDomain

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

liveVideo: streaming domain. If you set DomainName (the domain name to be connected to ApsaraVideo Live) to a streaming domain, you must set this parameter to liveVideo.
liveEdge: edge ingest domain. If you set DomainName (the domain name to be connected to ApsaraVideo Live) to an ingest domain, you must set this parameter to liveEdge
parameters.help_zh:
域名业务类型。取值：

liveVideo：播流域名。如果选择DomainName（需要接入直播的域名）为播流域名时，则域名业务类型必须选择为liveVideo。
liveEdge：边缘推流域名。如果选择DomainName（需要接入直播的域名）为推流域名时，则域名业务类型必须选择为liveEdge
parameters.name: live_domain_type

parameters.help_en: The ingest domain or streaming domain to be connected to ApsaraVideo Live. Wildcard domain names are supported and must start with a period (.)
parameters.help_zh: 需要接入直播的推流域名或播流域名。支持泛域名，以英文句号（.）开头
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The unit information of the live streaming domain name. Valid values:

cn-beijing: Beijing.
cn-shanghai: Shanghai.
cn-shenzhen: Shenzhen.
cn-qingdao: Qingdao.
ap-southeast-1: Singapore.
eu-central-1: Germany.
ap-northeast-1: Tokyo.
ap-southeast-5: Jakarta.

Region (unit information of the live streaming domain name) and Scope (acceleration region) do not restrict each other
parameters.help_zh:
直播域名单元化信息。取值：

cn-beijing：北京。
cn-shanghai：上海。
cn-shenzhen：深圳。
cn-qingdao：青岛。
ap-southeast-1：新加坡。
eu-central-1：德国。
ap-northeast-1：东京。
ap-southeast-5：雅加达。

Region（直播域名单元化信息）与Scope（加速区域）之间不存在相互限制
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The acceleration region. This parameter takes effect for international users and China site users at L3 or above. Valid values:

domestic (default): the Chinese mainland.
overseas: outside the Chinese mainland, including Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China).
global: global acceleration
parameters.help_zh:
加速区域。国际用户、中国站L3及以上用户设置有效。取值：

domestic（默认值）：中国内地。
overseas：海外及港澳台加速。
global：全球加速
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en: The top-level domain name for access
parameters.name: top_level_domain

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID。关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2381067.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id
